data.one_liner: Generates and visualizes audio waveforms while recording or playing audio files in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to record audio and display a real-time waveform visualization. It also supports playing audio files with waveform rendering, gesture controls for seeking or scrolling, and waveform extraction.
use_when: You need to build a voice recorder app with live waveform feedback.
You want to display audio waveforms for playback with gesture controls like seeking and scrolling.
avoid_when: You only need basic background audio playback without waveform visualizations.
You require cross-platform support outside of Android and iOS.
strengths: Gesture controls to scroll through waveforms or seek positions
Customizable styling with colors, gradients, and appearance options
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms
Not documented for platforms beyond Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires standard audio recording and storage permissions on Android and iOS.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need robust multi-platform audio playback and recording without specialized waveform visualization requirements.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you require advanced audio playback capabilities, gapless playback, and complex playlist management.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to capture and record audio without UI waveform components.
